ex.en: The paper is currently under peer review.
ex.zh: 這篇論文正在接受同儕審查。

ex.en: Peer review helps to keep research quality high.
ex.zh: 同儕審查有助於維持研究品質。

ex.en: Printers and scanners are common peripherals.
ex.zh: 印表機和掃描器是常見的周邊設備。

ex.en: This laptop has ports for many peripherals.
ex.zh: 這台筆電有很多可以接周邊設備的連接埠。

ex.en: Peripheral vision helps you see things at the side.
ex.zh: 周邊視覺讓你看到旁邊的東西。

ex.en: That issue is only peripheral to our discussion.
ex.zh: 那個問題和我們的討論只是枝節。

ex.en: She keeps a parrot as a pet.
ex.zh: 她養一隻鸚鵡作為寵物。

ex.en: Do you have any pets?
ex.zh: 你有養寵物嗎？

ex.en: She kept various kinds of pets.
ex.zh: 她養了各式各樣的寵物。

ex.en: He was petting the dog.
ex.zh: 他在撫摸那隻狗。

ex.en: Can I pet your dog?
ex.zh: 我可以摸摸你的狗嗎？

ex.en: We gave the performer a round of applause.
ex.zh: 我們為表演者鼓掌。

ex.en: Tom is a street performer.
ex.zh: 湯姆是街頭藝人。

ex.en: With both song and dance, the performers put on an excellent show.
ex.zh: 表演者又唱又跳，帶來一場精彩的演出。

performer.zh: （工作、投資等）表現…的人或事物

ex.en: Amy is one of our top performers.
ex.zh: Amy 是我們表現最好的員工之一。

ex.en: The stock was the best performer this year.
ex.zh: 這支股票是今年表現最好的。

ex.en: Please check your email periodically.
ex.zh: 請定期查看你的電子郵件。

ex.en: The software updates itself periodically.
ex.zh: 這個軟體會定期自動更新。

ex.en: We periodically review our prices.
ex.zh: 我們會定期檢討價格。

ex.en: The library has many scientific periodicals.
ex.zh: 圖書館有很多科學期刊。

ex.en: She writes for several periodicals.
ex.zh: 她替好幾份期刊撰稿。

ex.en: The machines need periodical checks.
ex.zh: 這些機器需要定期檢查。

ex.en: We send periodical updates to our clients.
ex.zh: 我們會定期寄送最新消息給客戶。

ex.en: Over a thousand people signed the petition.
ex.zh: 超過一千人在請願書上連署。

ex.en: Residents started a petition against the new road.
ex.zh: 居民發起連署反對興建新道路。

ex.en: Parents petitioned the school to change the rule.
ex.zh: 家長向學校請願要求修改規定。

ex.en: They petitioned the city for a new park.
ex.zh: 他們向市政府請願興建新公園。

personalize.zh: 使個人化、客製化（如印上姓名）

ex.en: You can personalize your phone's home screen.
ex.zh: 你可以把手機主畫面設定成自己的風格。

ex.en: The website personalizes ads based on your interests.
ex.zh: 這個網站會根據你的興趣提供個人化廣告。

ex.en: We can personalize the mug with your name.
ex.zh: 我們可以在馬克杯上印上你的名字。

ex.en: Players will be penalized for being late.
ex.zh: 遲到的球員會受罰。

ex.en: The company was penalized for breaking safety rules.
ex.zh: 這家公司因違反安全規定而被處罰。

ex.en: The new tax rules penalize small businesses.
ex.zh: 新的稅制對小型企業不利。

ex.en: The system penalizes people who work part-time.
ex.zh: 這個制度對兼職工作者不利。

ex.en: I seasoned the fish with salt and pepper.
ex.zh: 我用鹽和胡椒幫魚調味。

ex.en: Pass me the salt and pepper, please.
ex.zh: 請把鹽和胡椒遞給我。

ex.en: She hates green peppers.
ex.zh: 她討厭青椒。

ex.en: I don't want red bell peppers, I want green ones.
ex.zh: 我不要紅甜椒，我要綠的。

ex.en: The store has permanently closed.
ex.zh: 這家店已經永久歇業了。

ex.en: He moved to Canada permanently.
ex.zh: 他永久移居加拿大了。

ex.en: He learnt the periodic table by heart just for fun.
ex.zh: 他把元素週期表背下來只是為了好玩。

ex.en: The machine needs periodic maintenance.
ex.zh: 這台機器需要定期保養。

ex.en: We do periodic checks on all equipment.
ex.zh: 我們會定期檢查所有設備。

ex.en: When did the petrol gauge stop working?
ex.zh: 油表是什麼時候開始壞掉的？

ex.en: We need to stop for petrol soon.
ex.zh: 我們得趕快停下來加油。

ex.en: Petrol prices have gone up again.
ex.zh: 汽油價格又漲了。

ex.en: She persists in saying that her analysis is correct.
ex.zh: 她堅稱自己的分析是正確的。

ex.en: He persisted in his work until he succeeded.
ex.zh: 他堅持工作，直到成功為止。

ex.en: If the pain persists, see a doctor.
ex.zh: 如果持續疼痛，請就醫。

ex.en: Problems with the system persisted for weeks.
ex.zh: 系統問題持續了好幾週。

ex.en: Country life is very peaceful in comparison with city life.
ex.zh: 和都市生活相比，鄉村生活平靜多了。

ex.en: Jennifer lives a peaceful life in the small village, unlike us with our busy city lives.
ex.zh: 珍妮佛在小村莊裡過著平靜的生活，不像我們在城市裡那麼忙碌。

ex.en: The world which I saw in my dream was a peaceful world devoid of war.
ex.zh: 我在夢裡看到的是一個沒有戰爭、和平的世界。

ex.en: Both sides hope for a peaceful solution.
ex.zh: 雙方都希望能和平解決。

ex.en: Let's not argue over petty details.
ex.zh: 我們別為了瑣碎的細節爭吵。

ex.en: Don't waste your time on petty problems.
ex.zh: 別把時間浪費在小問題上。

ex.en: It was petty of him to complain about such a small amount.
ex.zh: 他為了這麼一點錢抱怨，真是小氣。

ex.en: She made a petty comment about my clothes.
ex.zh: 她對我的衣服說了些小心眼的話。

ex.en: You can take the money from petty cash.
ex.zh: 你可以從零用金裡拿這筆錢。

ex.en: Who is in charge of the petty cash?
ex.zh: 誰負責管理零用金？

ex.en: A product that costs 10 reals in Brazil costs about 25 pesos in Argentina.
ex.zh: 在巴西賣 10 雷亞爾的商品，在阿根廷大約要 25 披索。

ex.en: The Mexican peso rose against the dollar.
ex.zh: 墨西哥披索對美元升值。

ex.en: I hung my hat on the peg.
ex.zh: 我把帽子掛在掛鉤上。

ex.en: Hang your coat on the peg by the door.
ex.zh: 把外套掛在門邊的掛鉤上。

ex.en: The currency is pegged to the US dollar.
ex.zh: 這種貨幣與美元掛鉤。

ex.en: Prices were pegged at last year's level.
ex.zh: 價格被固定在去年的水準。

ex.en: The idea of perpetual motion is an absurd hypothesis.
ex.zh: 永動機的概念是個荒謬的假說。

ex.en: The city has a perpetual traffic problem.
ex.zh: 這座城市的交通問題永遠解決不了。

ex.en: Our industry is in a perpetual state of change.
ex.zh: 我們的產業一直處在不斷變化之中。

pensioner.zh: 領退休金的人、退休人士

ex.en: Many pensioners live on a fixed income.
ex.zh: 許多退休人士靠固定收入過活。

ex.en: The bus is free for pensioners.
ex.zh: 退休人士搭公車免費。

ex.en: The contract is still pending approval.
ex.zh: 這份合約還在等待核准。

ex.en: We have three pending orders.
ex.zh: 我們有三筆待處理的訂單。

ex.en: The decision has been postponed pending further review.
ex.zh: 決定延後，等待進一步審查。

ex.en: He was suspended pending an investigation.
ex.zh: 在調查結果出來前，他被停職了。

ex.en: Be patient and persistent. These things take time.
ex.zh: 要有耐心、堅持下去，這些事需要時間。

ex.en: His success is due more to his persistent hard work than to his talent.
ex.zh: 他的成功與其說來自天分，不如說來自持之以恆的努力。

ex.en: I have a persistent cough that won't go away.
ex.zh: 我一直咳嗽，怎麼都好不了。

ex.en: Persistent rain caused delays across the city.
ex.zh: 持續降雨造成全市交通延誤。

ex.en: The UN sent a peacekeeping force to the region.
ex.zh: 聯合國派遣維和部隊到該地區。

ex.en: She served on a peacekeeping mission in Africa.
ex.zh: 她曾在非洲參與維和任務。

ex.en: Most people only want to hear their own truth.
ex.zh: 大部分的人只想聽自己認定的真相。

ex.en: How many people will attend the meeting?
ex.zh: 有多少人會出席這場會議？

ex.en: There are a lot of different peoples in the world.
ex.zh: 世界上有許多不同的民族。

ex.en: There are several peoples in the country.
ex.zh: 這個國家有好幾個民族。

ex.en: I have never come across such a stubborn person.
ex.zh: 我從沒遇過這麼固執的人。

ex.en: This elevator is capable of carrying 10 persons at a time.
ex.zh: 這部電梯一次能載 10 個人。

ex.en: You need to sign the form in person.
ex.zh: 你必須親自簽署這份表格。

ex.en: It's nice to finally meet you in person.
ex.zh: 很高興終於見到你本人。

ex.en: Ten years is a really long period of time.
ex.zh: 十年真的是一段很長的時間。

ex.en: I looked after him for a period of time.
ex.zh: 我照顧了他一段時間。

ex.en: The students' lunch period is from twelve to one.
ex.zh: 學生的午餐時間是十二點到一點。

ex.en: In the Edo period, moon-viewing parties were very popular.
ex.zh: 在江戶時代，賞月宴會非常流行。

ex.en: We live in a wonderful period.
ex.zh: 我們生活在一個很棒的時代。

ex.en: What do you have the first period?
ex.zh: 你第一節是什麼課？

ex.en: We have English in the third period.
ex.zh: 我們第三節是英文課。

ex.en: Perhaps you are right, I have been selfish.
ex.zh: 也許你說得對，我一直都很自私。

ex.en: Perhaps it will rain in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下午也許會下雨。

ex.en: It's the police, perhaps we should get out of their way.
ex.zh: 是警察，也許我們該讓路。

ex.en: More than 40 percent of the students go to university.
ex.zh: 超過四成的學生會上大學。

ex.en: They obtained a yield of 8 percent on their investment.
ex.zh: 他們的投資獲得了百分之八的報酬。

ex.en: Tom sells T-shirts at a 30 percent discount.
ex.zh: 湯姆的T恤打七折賣。

ex.en: We may combine your personal information with other information.
ex.zh: 我們可能會把您的個人資料和其他資訊結合。

ex.en: Tom doesn't care about protecting his personal information online.
ex.zh: 湯姆上網時不在乎保護自己的個人資料。

ex.en: Please forgive my asking such a personal question.
ex.zh: 請原諒我問這麼私人的問題。

ex.en: The manager made a personal visit to the client.
ex.zh: 經理親自拜訪客戶。

ex.en: She gave the matter her personal attention.
ex.zh: 她親自處理這件事。

ex.en: Mark performed in front of people.
ex.zh: 馬克在眾人面前表演。

ex.en: The students performed Hamlet.
ex.zh: 學生們演出了《哈姆雷特》。

ex.en: The band will perform live tonight.
ex.zh: 這個樂團今晚會現場演出。

ex.en: The doctor performed the surgery successfully.
ex.zh: 醫生順利完成了手術。

ex.en: The system performs a backup every night.
ex.zh: 系統每晚都會執行備份。

ex.en: Most teams perform better when they have a home game.
ex.zh: 大多數球隊在主場比賽時表現得比較好。

ex.en: Our sales team performed well this quarter.
ex.zh: 我們的業務團隊這一季表現很好。

ex.en: Each movement of the dancer was perfect.
ex.zh: 這位舞者的每個動作都很完美。

ex.en: This English composition is far from perfect.
ex.zh: 這篇英文作文還差得遠呢。

ex.en: Nothing in the world is flawless and perfect.
ex.zh: 世界上沒有十全十美的東西。

ex.en: She spent a year in London to perfect her English.
ex.zh: 她在倫敦待了一年，讓英文更精進。

ex.en: The chef perfected the recipe over many years.
ex.zh: 主廚花了多年把這道食譜改良到完美。

ex.en: What percentage of all taxi drivers make unscrupulous detours, do you think?
ex.zh: 你覺得故意繞遠路的計程車司機佔了多少百分比？

ex.en: A large percentage of our customers are students.
ex.zh: 我們有很大比例的顧客是學生。

ex.en: What percentage of the budget is spent on marketing?
ex.zh: 預算有多少百分比花在行銷上？

ex.en: We are all longing for peace in the world.
ex.zh: 我們都渴望世界和平。

ex.en: He worked hard for peace for these ten years.
ex.zh: 這十年來，他一直為和平努力。

ex.en: Our ultimate goal is to establish world peace.
ex.zh: 我們的最終目標是建立世界和平。

ex.en: I just want some peace and quiet.
ex.zh: 我只想要一點清靜。

ex.en: Can you leave me in peace for an hour?
ex.zh: 你能讓我安靜一個小時嗎？

ex.en: Try to see things from the customer's perspective.
ex.zh: 試著從顧客的角度看事情。

ex.en: Living abroad gave me a new perspective on life.
ex.zh: 住在國外讓我對人生有了新的看法。

ex.en: From a business perspective, the plan makes sense.
ex.zh: 從商業角度來看，這個計畫是合理的。

perspective.zh: 正確看待事情的態度（keep / put in perspective）

ex.en: Try to keep things in perspective.
ex.zh: 試著用正確的角度看待事情。

ex.en: Losing one client isn't the end of the world; let's put it in perspective.
ex.zh: 失去一個客戶不是世界末日，我們要理性看待。

ex.en: I get a kick out of her cheerful personality.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡她開朗的個性。

ex.en: She has a very open personality.
ex.zh: 她的個性很坦率。

ex.en: There are a lot of things you don't know about my personality.
ex.zh: 你對我的個性還有很多不了解的地方。

ex.en: Noted literary personalities gathered together last evening.
ex.zh: 知名文學界人士昨晚齊聚一堂。

ex.en: He is a well-known TV personality.
ex.zh: 他是知名的電視名人。

ex.en: The peak of Fujiyama was covered with snow.
ex.zh: 富士山頂覆蓋著白雪。

ex.en: We reached the peak after a four-hour climb.
ex.zh: 我們爬了四個小時才登上山頂。

ex.en: The excitement reached its peak.
ex.zh: 興奮的情緒到達了頂點。

ex.en: Sales reach their peak in December.
ex.zh: 銷售量在十二月達到高峰。

ex.en: Tickets are more expensive during peak season.
ex.zh: 旺季時票價比較貴。

ex.en: Avoid driving during peak hours.
ex.zh: 盡量避開尖峰時段開車。

ex.en: Prices peaked in 2021.
ex.zh: 價格在 2021 年達到高峰。

ex.en: Traffic usually peaks around 6 p.m.
ex.zh: 車流量通常在傍晚六點左右達到高峰。

ex.en: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.
ex.zh: 正職工作比臨時工作好。

ex.en: Please give me your permanent address.
ex.zh: 請給我你的永久地址。

ex.en: Absolutely nothing is permanent in life.
ex.zh: 人生中沒有什麼是永久的。

ex.en: All that you say is perfectly correct.
ex.zh: 你說的完全正確。

ex.en: I understand your position perfectly.
ex.zh: 我完全理解你的立場。

ex.en: Your conduct is perfectly legal.
ex.zh: 你的行為完全合法。

ex.en: That word describes it perfectly.
ex.zh: 這個字形容得恰到好處。

ex.en: The dress fits you perfectly.
ex.zh: 這件洋裝你穿起來非常合身。

ex.en: I will personally visit you.
ex.zh: 我會親自去拜訪你。

ex.en: I know Tom personally.
ex.zh: 我私下認識湯姆。

ex.en: The CEO personally thanked every employee.
ex.zh: 執行長親自向每位員工道謝。

ex.en: Personally, I prefer working from home.
ex.zh: 就我個人而言，我比較喜歡在家工作。

ex.en: Personally, I think it's a great idea.
ex.zh: 我個人認為這是個好主意。

personally.zh: take it personally：當作是針對自己、往心裡去

ex.en: Don't take it personally.
ex.zh: 別往心裡去。

ex.en: He takes every criticism personally.
ex.zh: 他把每一句批評都當成是針對他。

ex.en: Children imitate their peers rather than their parents.
ex.zh: 孩子比較會模仿同儕，而不是父母。

ex.en: Teenagers often feel pressure from their peers.
ex.zh: 青少年常感受到來自同儕的壓力。

ex.en: My cat peers bemusedly at her reflection in the water.
ex.zh: 我的貓困惑地盯著自己在水中的倒影。

ex.en: She peered through the window to see who was there.
ex.zh: 她從窗戶往外仔細看是誰在那裡。

ex.en: People over 65 can receive a pension from the government.
ex.zh: 65 歲以上的人可以向政府領取退休金。

ex.en: My father lives on his pension.
ex.zh: 我父親靠退休金過活。

ex.en: The company offers a good pension plan.
ex.zh: 這家公司提供不錯的退休金方案。

ex.en: She tried to persuade him to attend the meeting.
ex.zh: 她試著說服他參加會議。

ex.en: I persuaded him to give up the idea.
ex.zh: 我說服他放棄了這個想法。

ex.en: I finally persuaded him to buy it.
ex.zh: 我終於說服他買下來了。

ex.en: I perceive by your face that you have good news.
ex.zh: 從你的表情看得出你有好消息。

ex.en: I perceived a change in her attitude.
ex.zh: 我察覺到她的態度變了。

perceive.zh: 認為、視為（perceive A as B）

ex.en: The brand is perceived as high quality.
ex.zh: 這個品牌被視為高品質的代表。

ex.en: Many people perceive him as arrogant.
ex.zh: 很多人認為他很傲慢。

ex.en: Perception is reality.
ex.zh: 認知即現實。

ex.en: Public perception of the brand has improved.
ex.zh: 大眾對這個品牌的印象改善了。

ex.en: The ad changed my perception of the company.
ex.zh: 這支廣告改變了我對這家公司的看法。

ex.en: Lack of sleep can affect your perception.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足會影響你的感知能力。

ex.en: Color perception varies from person to person.
ex.zh: 每個人對顏色的感知不同。

ex.en: If you need a pen, I'll lend you one.
ex.zh: 如果你需要筆，我借你一支。

ex.en: This is the same pen that I lost yesterday.
ex.zh: 這支筆跟我昨天弄丟的那支一樣。

ex.en: Do you have a lot of pens?
ex.zh: 你有很多支筆嗎？

ex.en: The teacher granted me permission to go home early.
ex.zh: 老師准許我提早回家。

ex.en: You shouldn't read other people's private letters without permission.
ex.zh: 你不應該未經允許就看別人的私人信件。

ex.en: I have to ask my dad for permission.
ex.zh: 我得先問我爸同不同意。

ex.en: You don't have permission to open this folder.
ex.zh: 你沒有開啟這個資料夾的權限。

ex.en: Ask IT to give you permission to edit the file.
ex.zh: 請資訊部門給你編輯這個檔案的權限。

ex.en: There is a penalty for late payment.
ex.zh: 逾期付款會被罰款。

ex.en: You'll pay a penalty if you cancel the contract early.
ex.zh: 提前解約要支付違約金。

ex.en: We should abolish the death penalty.
ex.zh: 我們應該廢除死刑。

ex.en: The death penalty had been done away with in many states in the USA.
ex.zh: 美國很多州已經廢除了死刑。

ex.en: The fans went silent as they nervously watched the penalty shootout between the two teams.
ex.zh: 兩隊進行 PK 大戰時，球迷們都緊張得安靜下來。

ex.en: The referee gave the team a penalty in the last minute.
ex.zh: 裁判在最後一分鐘判給那支球隊罰球。

ex.en: As usual the peasants are busy scattering grain seeds.
ex.zh: 農民們和往常一樣忙著播種。

ex.en: Most peasants in the village grew rice.
ex.zh: 村裡大部分農民都種稻。

ex.en: Farmers are fighting pests that destroy their crops.
ex.zh: 農民正在對抗破壞農作物的害蟲。

ex.en: Cockroaches are common household pests.
ex.zh: 蟑螂是常見的居家害蟲。

ex.en: My little brother can be a real pest.
ex.zh: 我弟弟有時候真的很煩人。

ex.en: Stop being such a pest and let me work.
ex.zh: 別再煩我了，讓我工作。

ex.en: Wash fruit well to remove pesticides.
ex.zh: 水果要洗乾淨才能去除農藥。

ex.en: These vegetables are grown without pesticides.
ex.zh: 這些蔬菜是不用農藥種的。

perverse.zh: 故意作對的、違反常理的

ex.en: It seems perverse to raise prices when sales are falling.
ex.zh: 在銷量下滑時漲價，似乎有違常理。

ex.en: He takes a perverse pleasure in arguing with everyone.
ex.zh: 他以跟每個人唱反調為樂，真是彆扭。

ex.en: This baby penguin is too cute!
ex.zh: 這隻企鵝寶寶太可愛了！

ex.en: I like penguins.
ex.zh: 我喜歡企鵝。

ex.en: Penguins can't fly, but they swim very well.
ex.zh: 企鵝不會飛，但很會游泳。

ex.en: Don't be so pessimistic.
ex.zh: 不要感覺那麼悲觀。

ex.en: You're being too pessimistic.
ex.zh: 你太悲觀了。

ex.en: Everyone feels pessimistic.
ex.zh: 每個人都感到悲觀。

ex.en: This milk has a peculiar smell.
ex.zh: 這牛奶有特殊的氣味。

ex.en: "So what do you think of Mary?" "She has a rather peculiar appearance."
ex.zh: ”那你怎麼看瑪麗？“ ”她看起來挺古怪的。“

ex.en: He has a peculiar way of walking.
ex.zh: 他走路的樣子很奇特。

ex.en: He said with a perplexed expression, "I've heard nothing, so I can't say anything."
ex.zh: 他的目光十分困惑：「我甚麼也沒聽過，所以甚麼也說不出來。」

ex.en: The difficult riddle perplexed all the students.
ex.zh: 這個困難的謎語讓所有學生都百思不解。

ex.en: His strange behavior perplexed his friends.
ex.zh: 他古怪的行為讓朋友們摸不著頭腦。

ex.en: Mayuko always aims for perfection.
ex.zh: 麻由子總是追求完美。

ex.en: Perfection isn't good enough.
ex.zh: 完美還不夠好。

ex.en: The steak was cooked to perfection.
ex.zh: 那塊牛排煎得恰到好處。

ex.en: Optimism is like the lamp of hope. Pessimism [or negativity] is like a drug of sorrow.
ex.zh: 樂觀如明燈,照亮希望的前程. 消極如毒品,腐蝕健康的心靈.

ex.en: There is a growing sense of pessimism about the economy.
ex.zh: 人們對經濟的悲觀情緒日益升高。

ex.en: Her pessimism made it hard for her to enjoy the trip.
ex.zh: 她的悲觀讓她很難享受這趟旅行。

ex.en: Tell the doctor if you are allergic to penicillin.
ex.zh: 如果你對盤尼西林過敏，要告訴醫生。

ex.en: Penicillin was the first widely used antibiotic.
ex.zh: 青黴素是第一種被廣泛使用的抗生素。

ex.en: Perseverance, as you know, is the key to success.
ex.zh: 就像你們知道的那樣，毅力是成功的關鍵。

ex.en: I was surprised by his perseverance.
ex.zh: 我對他的堅持感到很驚訝。

ex.en: There's no success without perseverance.
ex.zh: 沒有堅持，就沒有成功。

ex.en: Have you ever been to the Korean Peninsula?
ex.zh: 你去過朝鮮半島嗎？

ex.en: Italy is a peninsula.
ex.zh: 義大利是一個半島。

ex.en: Only authorized personnel may enter this area.
ex.zh: 僅限授權人員進入此區。

ex.en: The hospital is short of medical personnel.
ex.zh: 醫院缺乏醫護人員。

ex.en: Please send your resume to Personnel.
ex.zh: 請把履歷寄到人事部。

ex.en: He works in the personnel department.
ex.zh: 他在人事部工作。

ex.en: He was able to put up remarkable performances at the sports competition.
ex.zh: 他在運動會上表現非常出色。

ex.en: I am not very satisfied with today's performance.
ex.zh: 我對我今天的表現不是很滿意。

ex.en: I'm not very pleased with my performance today.
ex.zh: 我對我今天的表現並不是很滿意。

ex.en: When I am in London, I will most probably go catch a few performances.
ex.zh: 我在倫敦的時候，應該會去看一兩場演出。

ex.en: Lately there have been constant dance rehearsals; Performances will be on Friday and Saturday.
ex.zh: 最近一直在排練舞蹈，週五和週六要演出。

ex.en: Employees get a per diem of 60 dollars for meals.
ex.zh: 員工每天有 60 美元的餐費津貼。

ex.en: The per diem covers food and local transportation.
ex.zh: 每日津貼涵蓋餐費和當地交通。

ex.en: He presented a persuasive case for the budget increase.
ex.zh: 他提出了有說服力的理由，支持增加預算。

ex.en: The proposal includes persuasive market data.
ex.zh: 這份提案附有具說服力的市場數據。

ex.en: A flexible schedule is a popular job perk.
ex.zh: 彈性工時是很受歡迎的工作福利。

ex.en: One perk of the role is paid professional training.
ex.zh: 這個職位的一項額外福利是提供帶薪專業訓練。

ex.en: Perishable goods must be stored at the right temperature.
ex.zh: 易腐商品必須以適當溫度保存。

ex.en: The shipment contains perishable food products.
ex.zh: 這批貨物包含易腐食品。

ex.en: We hire extra staff during the peak season.
ex.zh: 旺季期間我們會額外聘請人手。

ex.en: Shipping delays are common in the peak season.
ex.zh: 旺季時常會出現運送延誤。

ex.en: Tom is a pediatrician.
ex.zh: 湯姆是兒科醫師。

ex.en: Ask your pediatrician which vaccinations are due this year.
ex.zh: 請詢問兒科醫師今年需要接種哪些疫苗。

ex.en: The penthouse offers a clear view of the harbor.
ex.zh: 這間頂樓公寓可以清楚眺望港口。

ex.en: The hotel reserved its penthouse suite for the visiting director.
ex.zh: 飯店將頂層套房保留給來訪的主管。

ex.en: When the light is green, cars turning must yield to pedestrians.
ex.zh: 綠燈時，轉彎車輛必須禮讓行人。

ex.en: It was the morning rush hour, and there were a lot of passing pedestrians and cars.
ex.zh: 當時正是早上尖峰時間，路上行人和車輛很多。

ex.en: The interface of this website is somewhat pedestrian, but it’s simple.
ex.zh: 這個網站的介面沒有甚麼新意，但是卻很簡潔。

ex.en: His writing style is rather pedestrian.
ex.zh: 他的文筆相當平淡無奇。

ex.en: The two birds built a nest without a building permit.
ex.zh: 那兩隻鳥沒有建築許可就築了巢。

ex.en: You need a work permit to work in this country.
ex.zh: 在這個國家工作需要工作許可證。

ex.en: If time permits, I'll visit the museum.
ex.zh: 如果時間允許，我會去參觀博物館。

ex.en: Weather permitting, we will leave in an hour.
ex.zh: 天氣允許的話，我們一小時後出發。

ex.en: Do you think Tom will permit Mary to do that?
ex.zh: 你認為湯姆會允許瑪麗這麼做嗎？

ex.en: These rules pertain to all employees.
ex.zh: 這些規定適用於所有員工。

ex.en: Please send me any documents that pertain to the case.
ex.zh: 請把所有和這個案子有關的文件寄給我。
